subject: Intro + demo: coordinating CIO briefing and sponsor attendance

Subject: Intro + demo: coordinating CIO briefing and sponsor attendance

Hi Michael / Lisa,

Thanks again for the quick intro. Following up to schedule a short executive briefing + high-level demo of Redwood’s inference platform for the Optera leadership team. Our goal is a 30–45 minute session aimed at the CIO (Michael) and any additional sponsors to cover:

- Business outcomes we’ve delivered for similar customers (latency/cost improvements)
- High-level architecture and security posture (VPC / audit logs / KMS)
- Suggested pilot scope and timelines

Suggested windows next week (PT):
- Tue Apr 13 — 10:00–10:30 or 15:00–15:45
- Wed Apr 14 — 09:00–09:45 or 11:00–11:30

If Michael can only spare 30 minutes, we’ll compress to a focused exec briefing and schedule a deeper technical follow-up with Marissa. I’ve attached a short deck that we can tailor.

Please let us know which slot works best or propose alternate times.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0182

Neha — thanks, this looks good. Michael’s calendar is tight next week; he can do a 30-minute executive briefing but prefers it to be concise (no deep technical walkthrough). He also asked that any security/compliance details be summarized on one slide up front.

Available 30-min windows (PT):
- Tue Apr 13 — 10:00–10:30 (best)
- Wed Apr 14 — 11:00–11:30
- Thu Apr 15 — 09:00–09:30

If you can confirm Tue 10:00–10:30, I’ll send the calendar invite. Please include a one-slide security summary and 2–3 bullets on pilot ROI.

Thanks,

Optera
